name: zenborg
description: A garden for your attention, in Claude Code. You are the gardener; this is part of the toolshed. Plant your first garden, cultivate it every day (open and close the day, tend moments, a gentle fence when a session wanders toward the weeds you declared), and harvest what it teaches you (weekly and seasonal reflection). Plus a practice for the gap while the agent works, and a local-first attention log that never leaves your machine.
